title: Jukeboxxed
summary: Game concept for a 4-8 player same-room party game where players pick songs that exactly half the room can name, with round flow, guess rules and scoring.
notes: No frontmatter, no ADR/SPEC filename convention. Content describes product behavior, rules, scoring numbers (flagged as playtest starting point), non-MVP items and open playtest questions: requirements-like, not implementation, so PRD. No user-story or acceptance-criteria headings, hence medium. Filename slug lacks the SHA-256 suffix because hashing is not possible with the permitted tools (Read, Write, Grep, Glob); the orchestrator may rename.
